ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
en: (1) Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
(4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer[2016] -
enNotes: [2016]- i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

en: (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
(6) From among the jinn and mankind."[2017]
enNotes: [2017]- Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.
